message.reasoning_content:
We need to output JSON with lesson and final_answer. The lesson should state key distinguishing feature: the crime is intentional injury leading to death? Actually facts: multiple people attacked victim, victim died from knife wounds. The correct label is 故意伤害;窝藏、包庇. So they consider the main charge is intentional injury (not murder) maybe because the intent to kill not proven, only intent to cause injury. Also there is charge of harboring/abetting (窝藏、包庇). The wrong prediction was 故意杀人 (intentional homicide). So lesson: key is whether intent to kill is proven; if only intent to injure, label is 故意伤害. Also need to note separate charge of harboring/abetting.

Thus produce JSON.
